v1_compatibility.notes: No frozen /api/v1 path, request, response, envelope, ledger, or gameplay behavior changes. The bounded provider surface is additive under /api/v2 only.

account_boundary.public_signup: supported only for explicit signup intent when self-signup mode, provider method, operational switch, configuration readiness, and network-release latch are all true; defaults false
account_boundary.provider_user_creation: recoverable provider-subject pending allocation followed by inactive canonical user/wallet/link persistence and one active-user publication transition
account_boundary.first_link: active authenticated local-password user plus explicit confirmation, exact session, and browser owner
account_boundary.subsequent_signin: previous provider-subject link plus currently active canonical local or social user
account_boundary.social_signup_identity_key: provider plus provider subject; provider email is presentation metadata only
account_boundary.social_signup_recovery: same provider subject resumes one deterministic pending allocation; active link recovery may sign in after a lost response; revoked links are never resurrected by signup

provider_flags.runtime_available: provider configuration readiness AND its independent provider-network release latch

flow_security.transient_exchange_policy: a bounded provider-unavailable result releases the exact claimed flow to pending until original expiry; cryptographic, identity, and post-exchange failures consume it

durable_separation.metadata: HMAC digests for state, callback, browser, optional link user/session ownership, action, and lifecycle only
durable_separation.exchange_proofs: internal flow id, nonce, PKCE verifier, and expiry only

rollback.disable_provider_or_network_release: either false latch prevents new flows, callbacks, adapter construction, and continued provider-session authorization
rollback.unlink: removes one provider-user binding and revokes matching provider-authenticated sessions
rollback.local_password: remains available and is required for safe linking and unlinking; provider-created accounts cannot unlink their sole authority without a separately authenticated recovery path
rollback.social_signup_disable: prevents new signup starts and callbacks without disabling existing linked sign-in
rollback.social_identity_revocation: a missing link on a completed social enrollment requires account recovery and cannot be recreated through signup

repository_merge_approval: Workroom #25 owner comment 5027642551 authorizes only fully repaired disabled-by-default repository code for existing private-invite accounts.
live_enablement_gate: A separate future owner release must approve each provider console, credentials, exact callback, security/privacy/data-deletion checks, rollback, and deployment before either network-release latch becomes true.
gate_policy: Repository merge, configured credentials, green checks, or deployment do not enable any provider or signup method. Live provider network access, public signup, DNS, and unrestricted launch remain separately controlled by #336 and #209.
